description: Independence rules. Everything is a { value, label } pair: value is the stable key used by logic and stored data and never changes; label is the text people see and can be renamed freely. Treatments and relationships are defined once below and rules refer to them by value. Each rule lists, per treatment, the service lines it applies to and the tree relationships (measured from an audit client) that inherit it. Where a relationship falls under more than one treatment, the treatment listed first in 'treatments' wins, so keep it ordered strictest first. This file holds today's behaviour; nothing reads it yet.

serviceLinesNote: ["*"] means every service line. The wizard does not ask for a service line yet, so every treatment applies to all of them. Real service lines will be { value, label } pairs too.
